description: This file contains controller functions for denormalizing data related to projects, commits, and differential rows within a version control analysis system. It orchestrates calls to repositories for data retrieval and processing, and exposes several denormalization workflows.

methods.name: DenormalizeData
methods.description: Initiates the denormalization process for recent project views, differential rows, and recent commits based on the provided application configuration.

methods.name: denormalizeViewRecentProject
methods.description: Processes recent project views for each target specified in the configuration.

methods.name: denormalizeViewRecentProjectForTarget
methods.description: Denormalizes data for a specific project target, including obtaining the most recent differentials and updating the denormalized view.

methods.name: denormalizeDiffRows
methods.description: Processes differential rows for all targets, updating their denormalized state.

methods.name: denormalizeDiffRowsForTarget
methods.description: Handles denormalization of differential rows for a specific target.

methods.name: getMappedTarget
methods.description: Converts a DiffTarget into its mapped form using source repository logic.

methods.name: denormalizeViewRecentCommit
methods.description: Processes recent commit data for each target in the configuration.

methods.name: denormalizeViewRecentCommitGlobal
methods.description: Updates global denormalized data for top committers and tech areas.

methods.name: denormalizeCommitRows
methods.description: Denormalizes recent commits for a given target, including timestamp extraction.

methods.name: extractCommitHashes
methods.description: Utility to extract commit hash strings from commit rows.
